parts: I need suggestions on what to get my boyfriend for his birthday next week. We've been together for 11 months. But known each other for seven years.

Given what I know about you two, I wouldn't buy him something generic. You've known each other for **7 years**, been together **11 months**, and from everything you've shared, he's your **best friend, travel buddy, and partner in adventure**. The gift should feel personal and memorable.

Here are the ideas I'd rank highest:

### 1. A "7 Years in the Making" Experience (My favorite)
Instead of one gift, make it a birthday adventure.

Include:
- Breakfast together
- An activity he'd love (go-karts would fit your style since you two enjoy unique experiences)
- An incredible steak dinner
- End the night with a handwritten letter telling him how crazy it is that after seven years of friendship, you finally found your person.

That letter will probably be what he remembers most.

### 2. A Custom Leather Weekender Bag
Since you two travel all the time, get him a high-quality leather duffel with his initials or last name embossed.

Every trip the two of you take, he'll use it.

### 3. Build a "Adventure Box"
Fill it with things that represent your relationship:
- Favorite snacks
- A bottle of bourbon or whiskey if he enjoys it
- A framed picture of you two
- Tickets for a future adventure
- A handwritten coupon book ("One surprise road trip," "Breakfast in bed," etc.)

### 4. Something for the Farm
I remember he loves building things and working on the farm.

Ideas:
- A personalized metal farm sign with the family name.
- A custom leather tool belt.
- A premium pocket knife engraved with a meaningful date or short message.

### 5. GoPro or DJI Action Camera
Since he rides BMX/mountain bikes and likes adventures, this is something he'll actually use.

### 6. A Professional Couples Photo Session
Not cheesy.

A fun outdoor shoot that captures this season of life together, then have your favorite photo framed.

### 7. Luxury Watch
If your budget allows, a nice watch becomes something he'll wear every day and think of you.

### 8. "Open When..." Letters
Write 10-20 sealed letters:
- Open when you miss me.
- Open when you're stressed.
- Open when you need motivation.
- Open when you need to laugh.
- Open on our one-year anniversary.

Guys often keep these for years.

### 9. Custom Metal Wall Art
Since he likes making things and has a farm, a custom steel sign with his property, family name, or a meaningful design would be unique.

### 10. A Surprise Weekend
You already love traveling together. Book one night somewhere neither of you has been. Keep the destination a surprise until you're in the car.

## If money truly isn't an issue...

I'd combine a few things:

- A beautiful leather weekender bag.
- A handwritten letter.
- A framed photo of the two of you.
- A surprise overnight getaway with an amazing dinner.

That combination feels thoughtful rather than just expensive.

One question: **What's your budget?** Around **$300**, **$1,000**, or are you thinking **$2,000+**? That will help narrow down ideas that feel just right for him.
